list.query: SELECT substr(pubkey,1,12)||'…'||substr(pubkey,-6) AS __text, pubkey AS __value FROM (SELECT client,pubkey FROM summary UNION SELECT client,pubkey FROM events) WHERE client IN (${client:sqlstring}) GROUP BY pubkey ORDER BY pubkey

panels.title: Collector
panels.description: Affected = attestations missing at least one flag. Issue points = total missing source/target/head flags. Checked = observed attestation duties. Finalized observations only. Summary counts include whole hourly buckets. Coverage describes attempted epochs, not time before startup.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CASE WHEN value='MOCK DATA' THEN value WHEN CAST((SELECT value FROM meta WHERE key='heartbeat') AS REAL)<strftime('%s','now')-600 THEN 'Stale' ELSE value END FROM meta WHERE key='collector_state'
targets.queryText: SELECT CASE WHEN value='MOCK DATA' THEN value WHEN CAST((SELECT value FROM meta WHERE key='heartbeat') AS REAL)<strftime('%s','now')-600 THEN 'Stale' ELSE value END FROM meta WHERE key='collector_state'

targets.rawQueryText: WITH RECURSIVE hours(t) AS (SELECT CAST($__from/3600000 AS INTEGER)*3600 UNION ALL SELECT t+3600 FROM hours WHERE t+3600 <= $__to/1000 LIMIT 9000), totals AS (SELECT bucket,sum(source_miss) AS Source,sum(target_miss) AS Target,sum(head_miss) AS Head FROM summary WHERE bucket >= CAST($__from / 3600000 AS INTEGER)*3600 AND bucket <= $__to/1000 AND client IN (${client:sqlstring}) AND pubkey IN (${validator:sqlstring}) GROUP BY bucket) SELECT t AS time,Source,Target,Head FROM hours LEFT JOIN totals ON totals.bucket=hours.t ORDER BY t
targets.queryText: WITH RECURSIVE hours(t) AS (SELECT CAST($__from/3600000 AS INTEGER)*3600 UNION ALL SELECT t+3600 FROM hours WHERE t+3600 <= $__to/1000 LIMIT 9000), totals AS (SELECT bucket,sum(source_miss) AS Source,sum(target_miss) AS Target,sum(head_miss) AS Head FROM summary WHERE bucket >= CAST($__from / 3600000 AS INTEGER)*3600 AND bucket <= $__to/1000 AND client IN (${client:sqlstring}) AND pubkey IN (${validator:sqlstring}) GROUP BY bucket) SELECT t AS time,Source,Target,Head FROM hours LEFT JOIN totals ON totals.bucket=hours.t ORDER BY t

panels.title: Proposal outcomes · finalized
panels.description: Scheduled slot time, not network submission time. Misses require complete canonical evidence.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time,client AS Client,slot AS Slot,status AS Outcome FROM events WHERE time >= $__from/1000 AND time <= $__to/1000 AND client IN (${client:sqlstring}) AND pubkey IN (${validator:sqlstring}) AND kind='proposal' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Validators · ranked by component issues
panels.description: Each failed source/target/head flag adds one point. All-three failures add three. Sync counts committee positions, including duplicate assignments. Whole hourly buckets; at most 200 rows.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT client AS Client,pubkey AS Pubkey,substr(pubkey,1,12)||'…'||substr(pubkey,-6) AS Validator,
       sum(expected) AS Checked,sum(affected) AS Affected,sum(source_miss) AS Source,sum(target_miss) AS Target,sum(head_miss) AS Head,
       sum(source_miss+target_miss+head_miss) AS Points,round(100.0*sum(affected)/nullif(sum(expected),0),3) AS "Issue %",
       sum(sync_missed) AS "Sync missed",sum(sync_unknown) AS "Sync unknown"
       FROM summary WHERE bucket >= CAST($__from / 3600000 AS INTEGER)*3600 AND bucket <= $__to/1000 AND client IN (${client:sqlstring}) AND pubkey IN (${validator:sqlstring}) GROUP BY client,pubkey ORDER BY Points DESC LIMIT 200
targets.queryText:
SELECT client AS Client,pubkey AS Pubkey,substr(pubkey,1,12)||'…'||substr(pubkey,-6) AS Validator,
       sum(expected) AS Checked,sum(affected) AS Affected,sum(source_miss) AS Source,sum(target_miss) AS Target,sum(head_miss) AS Head,
       sum(source_miss+target_miss+head_miss) AS Points,round(100.0*sum(affected)/nullif(sum(expected),0),3) AS "Issue %",
       sum(sync_missed) AS "Sync missed",sum(sync_unknown) AS "Sync unknown"
       FROM summary WHERE bucket >= CAST($__from / 3600000 AS INTEGER)*3600 AND bucket <= $__to/1000 AND client IN (${client:sqlstring}) AND pubkey IN (${validator:sqlstring}) GROUP BY client,pubkey ORDER BY Points DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Attestation exceptions · good attestations omitted
panels.description: Participation flags, not monetary rewards. No observed inclusion is different from proven failure to submit. Most recent 200 exceptions in the selected range.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT time,client AS Client,substr(pubkey,1,12)||'…'||substr(pubkey,-6) AS Validator,epoch AS Epoch,
       CASE source WHEN 1 THEN '✓' ELSE 'Miss' END AS Source,CASE target WHEN 1 THEN '✓' ELSE 'Miss' END AS Target,
       CASE head WHEN 1 THEN '✓' ELSE 'Miss' END AS Head,score AS Points,delay AS "Delay slots",pubkey AS Pubkey
       FROM events WHERE time >= $__from/1000 AND time <= $__to/1000 AND client IN (${client:sqlstring}) AND pubkey IN (${validator:sqlstring}) AND kind='attestation' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 200
targets.queryText:
SELECT time,client AS Client,substr(pubkey,1,12)||'…'||substr(pubkey,-6) AS Validator,epoch AS Epoch,
       CASE source WHEN 1 THEN '✓' ELSE 'Miss' END AS Source,CASE target WHEN 1 THEN '✓' ELSE 'Miss' END AS Target,
       CASE head WHEN 1 THEN '✓' ELSE 'Miss' END AS Head,score AS Points,delay AS "Delay slots",pubkey AS Pubkey
       FROM events WHERE time >= $__from/1000 AND time <= $__to/1000 AND client IN (${client:sqlstring}) AND pubkey IN (${validator:sqlstring}) AND kind='attestation' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Collection coverage · unknown is not a validator failure

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT time,epoch AS Epoch,status AS Coverage,reason AS Reason,unknown_keys AS "Unregistered keys",CASE WHEN status='checked' OR coalesce((SELECT proposals_checked FROM backlog WHERE backlog.epoch=epochs.epoch),0)=1 THEN 'checked' ELSE 'unknown' END AS Proposals FROM epochs WHERE time >= $__from/1000 AND time <= $__to/1000 ORDER BY epoch DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Discord delivery
panels.description: Alerts are optional. Pending retries survive restarts. Failed deliveries need operator attention. Duplicate delivery is possible if the process crashes after Discord accepts a message.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT created AS time,CASE WHEN instr(id,':')>0 THEN substr(id,1,instr(id,':')-1) ELSE 'demo' END AS Alert,state AS State,attempts AS Attempts,last_status AS "HTTP status" FROM outbox ORDER BY created DESC LIMIT 30
targets.queryText: SELECT created AS time,CASE WHEN instr(id,':')>0 THEN substr(id,1,instr(id,':')-1) ELSE 'demo' END AS Alert,state AS State,attempts AS Attempts,last_status AS "HTTP status" FROM outbox ORDER BY created DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Recovery queue · recent epochs take priority
panels.description: Oldest 100 unresolved epochs, independent of the selected time range. Retry times are earliest eligibility, not appointments; live work and the historical cooldown take priority. Inventory confirmation is required when no historical observation exists. Proposal outcomes may be available while attestations remain unknown.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT e.time,b.epoch AS Epoch,
       CASE WHEN b.ownership IS NULL THEN 'Confirmation needed' ELSE 'Captured' END AS Inventory,
       CASE WHEN b.proposals_checked=1 THEN 'checked' ELSE 'unknown' END AS Proposals,
       b.attempts AS Attempts,CASE WHEN b.next_try>0 THEN b.next_try ELSE NULL END AS "Retry after",
       e.reason AS Reason,(SELECT count(*) FROM backlog) AS "Total queued"
       FROM backlog b JOIN epochs e ON e.epoch=b.epoch ORDER BY b.epoch LIMIT 100
targets.queryText:
SELECT e.time,b.epoch AS Epoch,

       FROM backlog b JOIN epochs e ON e.epoch=b.epoch ORDER BY b.epoch LIMIT 100
